description: PRD-203 — Auth Wrapper Migration. Roll the two well-built-but-barely-used auth wrappers (lib/api-auth.ts: withTenantAuth/withTenantAuthParams/withSuperAdmin/withSuperAdminParams/withAuth) out to all 107 app/api/**/route.ts files (only 12 use one today; ~95 hand-roll `getCurrentUser() + if(!user) return 401`). Delete the hand-rolled blocks; handlers read user/tenantId from the wrapper context arg. Fix two correctness bugs underneath: (1) getCurrentUser tenant resolution is host-blind and its email fallback is unscoped/ambiguity-blind — wire it to 205's ambiguity-aware canonical resolveTenant and add a typed UserNotProvisionedError for the Clerk user.created race; (2) customer/profile does a no-tenant findFirst({where:{email}}) on GET+PATCH = cross-tenant leak — wrap it and resolve within the bound tenant context. Add a ts-morph CI gate (scripts/check-auth-wrappers.ts + pnpm check:auth-wrappers) that fails the build on any unwrapped, non-allow-listed handler. STACKED on ralph/prd-205 @ 06674ce (chain 202->205->203): strict deps PRD-202 (wrapper composes runWithTenantContext) + PRD-205 (wrapper/getCurrentUser call the canonical resolver). Soft overlap with PRD-204 (validation runs inside the wrapped handler; both touch the same route files — expect merge-time reconciliation).

Default-deny intent documented: anything not on the allow-list MUST be wrapped

userStories.title: Harden getCurrentUser + resolve-tenant-id (AC-2/AC-2a)
userStories.description: As a newly-signed-up or multi-tenant user, my auth must resolve correctly: ambiguous email -> 403 (not a silent first-row pick), and a valid Clerk session with no DB row yet -> retryable 409 (not a silent unauthorized null).
acceptanceCriteria: getCurrentUser (lib/auth-helper.ts) resolves the tenant via 205's canonical resolveTenant({kind:'clerk'}) (isActive-enforced, ambiguity-aware) instead of the in-place unscoped email findFirst; on AmbiguousTenantResolution it returns/propagates a typed result the wrapper renders as 403 (not a guess)

A valid Clerk session whose DB user row does not exist yet returns a typed UserNotProvisionedError (-> 409 retryable) rather than null-that-looks-like-401; the Clerk user.created provisioning ordering is documented in a comment

resolve-tenant-id.ts keeps its signature; any remaining unscoped fallback is removed in favour of the canonical path (205 already made resolveTenantIdFromClerkOrg delegate — this story consumes its typed ambiguous result end-to-end)
Unit tests (tests/unit/auth-helper.test.ts): ambiguous email -> 403-typed path; valid session + no row -> UserNotProvisionedError; happy path -> {user, tenantId}
No console.log in prod code (structured console.warn for auth.tenant_resolution_ambiguous / auth.user_not_provisioned audit lines is acceptable)
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Tenant-scope + wrap customer/profile GET+PATCH (AC-3)
userStories.description: As tenant A's customer, /api/customer/profile must return only my tenant-A row even if a tenant-B user shares my email. Wrap the route and resolve within the bound tenant context.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/customer/profile/route.ts GET + PATCH are wrapped (withAuth or withTenantAuth) so they run inside one bound tenant scope; the hand-rolled currentUser()/getCurrentUser block is deleted

The findFirst({where:{email}}) at :25 and the PATCH lookup at :79 are tenant-scoped — either an explicit tenantId filter or reliance on the now-bound Prisma $use scoping (PRD-202) — so a tenant-A session can never read or mutate a tenant-B row sharing the email
Success payload shape is unchanged for the legitimate same-tenant caller
Unit test (tests/unit/customer-profile.test.ts) with prisma mocked: the GET/PATCH lookups are issued with a tenant filter (or under a bound context); no unscoped email-only query remains
Cross-tenant proof against real Postgres is deferred to US-010 (Docker-gated) and US-011 (E2E)
